response.sql:
WITH account_totals AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        d.A3 AS region,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount
                 WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount
                 ELSE NULL END) AS account_total,
        COUNT(t.trans_id) AS transaction_count
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    LEFT JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3
),
region_totals AS (
    SELECT region, SUM(account_total) AS region_total
    FROM account_totals
    GROUP BY region
)
SELECT
    at.account_id,
    at.region,
    at.account_total,
    at.transaction_count,
    1.0 * at.account_total / NULLIF(rt.region_total, 0) AS share
FROM account_totals AS at
JOIN region_totals AS rt ON rt.region = at.region
ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Transaction totals are net totals: PRIJEM amounts count as credits and VYDAJ amounts as debits. VYBER rows have no documented direction, so they are excluded from the total; they are included in the transaction count. The region denominator sums the resulting account totals for accounts with an existing district.

alternatives.interpretation: Treat every transaction amount as a positive amount when totaling; this includes VYBER and computes each region’s denominator from those gross totals.
